method_note: Fresh re-derivation from writeup/data/arc6/manuscript_pages.txt. Inputs taken from outside the 12 nodes were read as statements (Prop 6.6/(6.30)-(6.32), Def 6.4/6.5, (6.6)-(6.7), Lemma 7.1/(7.9), Prop 7.2, 7.5, 7.6/(7.31)-(7.36), Lemma 7.7/(7.39), Cor 7.8, Prop 8.1/(8.3), Prop 8.3/(8.12)-(8.14), (5.41)-(5.43)); where a numerical fact in one of them was load-bearing ((6.7), (7.9), (5.43), (6.32), (8.17)) I recomputed it. Numeric checks were run with kappa_s = 1e-5 (scripts in the session scratchpad, results quoted in 'recomputed'). Garbled displays were resolved at the PDF geometry (fraction bars = drawings of height < 2).

Step 2 primitive: (d_r + e/r) sigma_e = -F_e + b_e M_e verified by differentiation and numerically; zero total moment since int r^e b_e dr = int x^e bhat_e dx = 1 (substitution r = sqrt(q) x); sigma_e compactly supported (numerically |sigma| < 1e-16 beyond the annulus). Sigma = Q^{2A}(sigma_2,sigma_1) in M_{C*-k} via (8.6) normalisation Q^{a-1/2} r^{-e} I_c,phys(r^e f_phys) = T_e f_* with a = 2A+1/2, and T_e preserving the class (Lemma 8.2).
Step 2 increment: Prop 7.6/(7.35)-(7.36): Sigma in M_{C*-k} gives Las Sigma in W_{C*-k-1/2} = W_{B-k}, and B(w0^tan, Las Sigma) = Sigma exactly (fixed a_sigma, H).

Step 2 wave table: linear B+1/2-4k (Prop 9.1 homogeneous case, alpha = B-k); mean interaction B-k+0.4; cross with old waves B-k+1/2-k = B+1/2-2k; self 2(B-k)-k = 2B-3k. All four rows rebuilt from Prop 9.1 and Lemma 9.2.

Delta g_r from the rr-component <w0 . t_s> in M_{C*-k}, D_r -> M_{C*-2k}, so Delta p_m in M_{C*-2k}, pressure effect on E_z gains one; bump term b_e M_e in M_{C*+1-k} by (9.12).

(9.14): 0.18-2k = 0.17998 > 0.17 and sigma_j - 3k >= 0.19997 > 0.17, so <E>_Y in M_{C*+0.17}; full E in M_{C*-2k} = M_H (Y-fluctuation of <w0 t_s>_theta is M_{C*-k}, divergence M_{C*-2k}); defects S_H.

steps_checked: (8.7) by differentiating (8.5): D_r = d_R + M d_r R^{d_r-1} L with L = v_r . d_y. For I g(R,y) = int_0^R g(R', y + M((R')^{d_r} - R^{d_r}) v_r) dR': d_R I g = g(R,y) - M d_r R^{d_r-1} int (v_r . d_y g) dR' and M d_r R^{d_r-1} L I g = + M d_r R^{d_r-1} int (v_r . d_y g) dR', so D_r I g = g; same computation with no endpoint gives D_r J g = 0; D_r(chi_m J g) = (d_R chi_m) J g since chi_m is Y-independent. Then (D_r + e/R)(R^{-e} I_c(R^e f)) = R^{-e}(R^e f - d_R chi_m J(R^e f)) - e R^{-e-1} I_c + e R^{-e-1} I_c = f - A_e f. Verified numerically with a y-periodic g and shift M = 3, d_r = 1.3, v_r = 0.7: D_r I g = 0.37472 vs g = 0.37476, D_r J g = 0, (8.7) lhs 0.347783 vs rhs 0.347788 (finite-difference floor).

Equivalent (8.9) form: with U = R^{d_r}, u = U' - U, the integrand F(U+u, y+M u v_r) has (d_U + M L) = d/du, sending A_- to F, A_+ to -F, J to 0; coefficient derivatives act on F and chi_m only (no factor M).

(8.10) from (6.7): |v_r . n| >= c/(1+|n|) because (n_1+n_2)^2 - 2 n_2^2 is a nonzero integer and the conjugate is O(|n|); numerically min |v_r . n|(1+|n|) = 0.385 over |n| <= 300. Multiplier (2 pi i v_r . k)^{-p} <= C(1+|k|)^p; C^m norm of L^{-p}H needs sum |k|^m (1+|k|)^p |Hhat(k)| <= ||H||_{C^{m+p+3}} sum (1+|k|)^{-3}, and sum over Z^2 of (1+|k|)^{-3} converges (partial sums 3.655, 3.662). Loss p + 3 confirmed.

(8.8): J g = (-M^{-1})^p int d_U^p L^{-p} F^o du by repeated d/du = d_U + M L on L^{-1}F^o (endpoint terms vanish, zero mode has zero full-line integral by the moment hypothesis); M^{-1} = Lambda_g^{-i0} Q^{-d_r/2} <= C eps^{kappa_s} S_*^{rho_g} from (6.6)/(6.4) (M_i ~ eps^{-kappa_s} S^{-rho_g} by the choice d_r = 2((1+h)rho_g - h kappa_s)); so J g, hence A_e f = R^{-e}(d_R chi_m) J(R^e f), gains eps^{p kappa_s} at the cost of p radial and p+3 torus derivatives. <A_e f>_Y = 0 by Haar translation invariance and the moment condition.
Flatness: for physical order N choose p with h(alpha + p kappa_s) > N + L; Y-independent f with zero moment: J(R^e f) = int R^e f dR = 0, remainder identically zero.
